29/**
30 * <p>Decodes Code 39 barcodes. Supports "Full ASCII Code 39" if USE_CODE_39_EXTENDED_MODE is set.</p>
31 *
32 * @author Sean Owen
33 * @see Code93Reader
34 */
35#[derive(OneDReader)]
36pub struct Code39Reader {
37    usingCheckDigit: bool,
38    extendedMode: bool,
39    decodeRowRXingResult: String,
40    // counters: Vec<u32>,
41}
42impl Default for Code39Reader {
43    fn default() -> Self {
44        Self::with_use_check_digit(false)
45    }
46}
47impl OneDReader for Code39Reader {
48    fn decode_row(
49        &mut self,
50        rowNumber: u32,
51        row: &crate::common::BitArray,
52        _hints: &DecodeHints,
53    ) -> Result<crate::RXingResult> {
54        let mut counters = [0_u32; 9];
55        self.decodeRowRXingResult.clear();
56
57        let start = Self::findAsteriskPattern(row, &mut counters)?;
58        // Read off white space
59        let mut nextStart = row.getNextSet(start[1] as usize);
60        let end = row.get_size();
61
62        let mut decodedChar;
63        let mut lastStart;
64        loop {
65            one_d_reader::record_pattern(row, nextStart, &mut counters)?;
66            let pattern = Self::toNarrowWidePattern(&counters);
67            if pattern < 0 {
68                return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
69            }
70            decodedChar = Self::patternToChar(pattern as u32)?;
71            self.decodeRowRXingResult.push(decodedChar);
72            lastStart = nextStart;
73            for counter in &counters {
74                nextStart += *counter as usize;
75            }
76            // Read off white space
77            nextStart = row.getNextSet(nextStart);
78
79            if decodedChar == '*' {
80                break;
81            }
82        }
83        self.decodeRowRXingResult
84            .truncate(self.decodeRowRXingResult.len() - 1); // remove asterisk
85
86        // Look for whitespace after pattern:
87        let lastPatternSize = counters.iter().sum::<u32>();
88
89        let whiteSpaceAfterEnd = nextStart - lastStart - lastPatternSize as usize;
90        // If 50% of last pattern size, following last pattern, is not whitespace, fail
91        // (but if it's whitespace to the very end of the image, that's OK)
92        if nextStart != end && (whiteSpaceAfterEnd * 2) < lastPatternSize as usize {
93            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
94        }
95
96        let cached_row_result = self.decodeRowRXingResult.chars().collect::<Vec<_>>();
97
98        if self.usingCheckDigit {
99            let max = cached_row_result.len() - 1;
100            let mut total = 0;
101            for i in 0..max {
102                if let Some(pos) = Self::ALPHABET_STRING.find(
103                    *cached_row_result
104                        .get(i)
105                        .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?,
106                ) {
107                    total += pos;
108                }
109            }
110            if cached_row_result
111                .get(max)
112                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?
113                != C39R_CACHED_ALPHABET_STRING
114                    .get(total % 43)
115                    .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?
116            {
117                return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
118            }
119            self.decodeRowRXingResult.truncate(max);
120        }
121
122        if self.decodeRowRXingResult.chars().count() == 0 {
123            // false positive
124            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
125        }
126
127        let resultString = if self.extendedMode {
128            Self::decodeExtended(&self.decodeRowRXingResult)?
129        } else {
130            self.decodeRowRXingResult.clone()
131        };
132
133        let left = (start[1] + start[0]) as f32 / 2.0;
134        let right = (lastStart + lastPatternSize as usize) as f32 / 2.0;
135
136        let mut resultObject = RXingResult::new(
137            &resultString,
138            Vec::new(),
139            vec![
140                point(left, rowNumber as f32),
141                point(right, rowNumber as f32),
142            ],
143            BarcodeFormat::CODE_39,
144        );
145
146        resultObject.putMetadata(
147            RXingResultMetadataType::SYMBOLOGY_IDENTIFIER,
148            RXingResultMetadataValue::SymbologyIdentifier("]A0".to_owned()),
149        );
150
151        Ok(resultObject)
152    }
153}

155pub static C39R_CACHED_ALPHABET_STRING: Lazy<Vec<char>> =
156    Lazy::new(|| Code39Reader::ALPHABET_STRING.chars().collect());
157
158impl Code39Reader {
159    pub const ALPHABET_STRING: &'static str = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ-. $/+%";
160
161    /**
162     * These represent the encodings of characters, as patterns of wide and narrow bars.
163     * The 9 least-significant bits of each int correspond to the pattern of wide and narrow,
164     * with 1s representing "wide" and 0s representing narrow.
165     */
166    pub const CHARACTER_ENCODINGS: [u32; 43] = [
167        0x034, 0x121, 0x061, 0x160, 0x031, 0x130, 0x070, 0x025, 0x124, 0x064, // 0-9
168        0x109, 0x049, 0x148, 0x019, 0x118, 0x058, 0x00D, 0x10C, 0x04C, 0x01C, // A-J
169        0x103, 0x043, 0x142, 0x013, 0x112, 0x052, 0x007, 0x106, 0x046, 0x016, // K-T
170        0x181, 0x0C1, 0x1C0, 0x091, 0x190, 0x0D0, 0x085, 0x184, 0x0C4, 0x0A8, // U-$
171        0x0A2, 0x08A, 0x02A, // /-%
172    ];
173
174    pub const ASTERISK_ENCODING: u32 = 0x094;
175
176    /**
177     * Creates a reader that assumes all encoded data is data, and does not treat the final
178     * character as a check digit. It will not decoded "extended Code 39" sequences.
179     */
180    pub fn new() -> Self {
181        Self::with_use_check_digit(false)
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * Creates a reader that can be configured to check the last character as a check digit.
186     * It will not decoded "extended Code 39" sequences.
187     *
188     * @param usingCheckDigit if true, treat the last data character as a check digit, not
189     * data, and verify that the checksum passes.
190     */
191    pub fn with_use_check_digit(usingCheckDigit: bool) -> Self {
192        Self::with_all_config(usingCheckDigit, false)
193    }
194
195    /**
196     * Creates a reader that can be configured to check the last character as a check digit,
197     * or optionally attempt to decode "extended Code 39" sequences that are used to encode
198     * the full ASCII character set.
199     *
200     * @param usingCheckDigit if true, treat the last data character as a check digit, not
201     * data, and verify that the checksum passes.
202     * @param extendedMode if true, will attempt to decode extended Code 39 sequences in the
203     * text.
204     */
205    pub fn with_all_config(usingCheckDigit: bool, extendedMode: bool) -> Self {
206        Self {
207            usingCheckDigit,
208            extendedMode,
209            decodeRowRXingResult: String::with_capacity(20),
210            // counters: vec![0; 9],
211        }
212    }
213
214    fn findAsteriskPattern(row: &BitArray, counters: &mut [u32]) -> Result<Vec<u32>> {
215        let width = row.get_size();
216        let rowOffset = row.getNextSet(0);
217
218        let mut counterPosition = 0;
219        let mut patternStart = rowOffset;
220        let mut isWhite = false;
221        let patternLength = counters.len();
222
223        for i in rowOffset..width {
224            // for (int i = rowOffset; i < width; i++) {
225            if row.get(i) != isWhite {
226                counters[counterPosition] += 1;
227            } else {
228                if counterPosition == patternLength - 1 {
229                    // Look for whitespace before start pattern, >= 50% of width of start pattern
230                    if Self::toNarrowWidePattern(counters) == (Self::ASTERISK_ENCODING as i32)
231                        && row.isRange(
232                            0.max(
233                                patternStart as isize - ((i as isize - patternStart as isize) / 2),
234                            ) as usize,
235                            patternStart,
236                            false,
237                        )?
238                    {
239                        return Ok(vec![patternStart as u32, i as u32]);
240                        // return new int[]{patternStart, i};
241                    }
242                    patternStart += (counters[0] + counters[1]) as usize;
243
244                    counters.copy_within(2..(counterPosition - 1 + 2), 0);
245                    // System.arraycopy(counters, 2, counters, 0, counterPosition - 1);
246                    counters[counterPosition - 1] = 0;
247                    counters[counterPosition] = 0;
248                    counterPosition -= 1;
249                } else {
250                    counterPosition += 1;
251                }
252                counters[counterPosition] = 1;
253                isWhite = !isWhite;
254            }
255        }
256        Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND)
257    }
258
259    // For efficiency, returns -1 on failure. Not throwing here saved as many as 700 exceptions
260    // per image when using some of our blackbox images.
261    fn toNarrowWidePattern(counters: &[u32]) -> i32 {
262        let numCounters = counters.len();
263        let mut maxNarrowCounter = 0;
264        let mut wideCounters;
265        loop {
266            let mut minCounter = u32::MAX;
267            for counter in counters {
268                if counter < &minCounter && counter > &maxNarrowCounter {
269                    minCounter = *counter;
270                }
271            }
272            maxNarrowCounter = minCounter;
273            wideCounters = 0;
274            let mut totalWideCountersWidth = 0;
275            let mut pattern = 0;
276            for (i, counter) in counters.iter().enumerate().take(numCounters) {
277                if *counter > maxNarrowCounter {
278                    pattern |= 1 << (numCounters - 1 - i);
279                    wideCounters += 1;
280                    totalWideCountersWidth += *counter;
281                }
282            }
283            if wideCounters == 3 {
284                // Found 3 wide counters, but are they close enough in width?
285                // We can perform a cheap, conservative check to see if any individual
286                // counter is more than 1.5 times the average:
287                let mut i = 0;
288                while i < numCounters && wideCounters > 0 {
289                    let counter = counters[i];
290                    if counter > maxNarrowCounter {
291                        wideCounters -= 1;
292                        // totalWideCountersWidth = 3 * average, so this checks if counter >= 3/2 * average
293                        if (counter * 2) >= totalWideCountersWidth {
294                            return -1;
295                        }
296                    }
297
298                    i += 1;
299                }
300                return pattern;
301            }
302
303            if wideCounters <= 3 {
304                break;
305            }
306        }
307        -1
308    }
309
310    fn patternToChar(pattern: u32) -> Result<char> {
311        for i in 0..Self::CHARACTER_ENCODINGS.len() {
312            if Self::CHARACTER_ENCODINGS[i] == pattern {
313                return C39R_CACHED_ALPHABET_STRING
314                    .get(i)
315                    .copied()
316                    .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS);
317            }
318        }
319        if pattern == Self::ASTERISK_ENCODING {
320            return Ok('*');
321        }
322        Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND)
323    }
324
325    fn decodeExtended(encoded: &str) -> Result<String> {
326        let length = encoded.chars().count();
327        let mut decoded = String::with_capacity(length); //new StringBuilder(length);
328        let mut i = 0;
329        let cached_encoded = encoded.chars().collect::<Vec<_>>();
330        while i < length {
331            // for i in 0..length {
332            // for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
333            let c = *cached_encoded
334                .get(i)
335                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
336            if c == '+' || c == '$' || c == '%' || c == '/' {
337                let next = *cached_encoded
338                    .get(i + 1)
339                    .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
340                let mut decodedChar = '\0';
341                match c {
342                    '+' => {
343                        // +A to +Z map to a to z
344                        if next.is_ascii_uppercase() {
345                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 + 32)
346                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
347                        } else {
348                            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
349                        }
350                    }
351                    '$' => {
352                        // $A to $Z map to control codes SH to SB
353                        if next.is_ascii_uppercase() {
354                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 - 64)
355                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
356                        } else {
357                            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
358                        }
359                    }
360                    '%' => {
361                        // %A to %E map to control codes ESC to US
362                        if ('A'..='E').contains(&next) {
363                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 - 38)
364                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
365                        } else if ('F'..='J').contains(&next) {
366                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 - 11)
367                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
368                        } else if ('K'..='O').contains(&next) {
369                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 + 16)
370                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
371                        } else if ('P'..='T').contains(&next) {
372                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 + 43)
373                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
374                        } else if next == 'U' {
375                            decodedChar = 0 as char;
376                        } else if next == 'V' {
377                            decodedChar = '@';
378                        } else if next == 'W' {
379                            decodedChar = '`';
380                        } else if next == 'X' || next == 'Y' || next == 'Z' {
381                            decodedChar = 127 as char;
382                        } else {
383                            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
384                        }
385                    }
386                    '/' => {
387                        // /A to /O map to ! to , and /Z maps to :
388                        if ('A'..='O').contains(&next) {
389                            decodedChar = char::from_u32(next as u32 - 32)
390                                .ok_or(Exceptions::INDEX_OUT_OF_BOUNDS)?;
391                        } else if next == 'Z' {
392                            decodedChar = ':';
393                        } else {
394                            return Err(Exceptions::NOT_FOUND);
395                        }
396                    }
397                    _ => {}
398                }
399                decoded.push(decodedChar);
400                // bump up i again since we read two characters
401                i += 1;
402            } else {
403                decoded.push(c);
404            }
405            i += 1;
406        }
407        Ok(decoded)
408    }
409}

432    fn doTest(expectedRXingResult: &str, encodedRXingResult: &str) {
433        let mut sut = Code39Reader::with_all_config(false, true);
434        let matrix =
435            BitMatrix::parse_strings(encodedRXingResult, "1", "0").expect("bitmatrix parse");
436        // let row = BitArray::with_size(matrix.getWidth() as usize);
437        let row = matrix.getRow(0);
438        let result = sut
439            .decode_row(0, &row, &DecodeHints::default())
440            .expect("decode row");
441        assert_eq!(expectedRXingResult, result.getText());
442    }
